charts.titleId: Be, do, have: present dan past
charts.noteId: Pakai tabel ini saat mengubah waktu. Do dan have menjadi did dan had untuk semua subjek. Hanya be yang masih berubah menurut subjek di masa lalu.

It was stable.

charts.noteId: Bentuk lampau dan bentuk ketiga tidak memakai -ed. Pakai bentuk ketiga setelah have, has, had, dan setelah be pada kalimat pasif.

examples.en: We go to the war room.
We went to the war room.
We have gone to the war room.
examples.id: Kami sudah pergi ke war room.

examples.en: I send the note after the call.
I sent the note after the call.
I have sent the note.
She writes the postmortem.
She wrote the postmortem.
The postmortem is written.
We take the rollback path.
We took the rollback path.
The rollback path has been taken.
They make the decision today.
They made the decision today.
The decision has been made.
I see the gap in the graph.
I saw the gap in the graph.
I have seen this gap before.
examples.id: Saya sudah pernah melihat celah ini.

examples.en: The alert comes from billing.
The alert came from billing.
The alert has come from billing.
examples.id: Alert itu sudah datang dari billing.

examples.en: We get the token from the vault.
We got the token from the vault.
We have gotten the token.
The window begins at nine.
The window began at nine.
The window has begun.
The change breaks checkout.
The change broke checkout.
Checkout is broken.
We choose the safer path.
examples.id: Kami memilih jalur yang lebih aman.

examples.en: We chose the safer path.
examples.id: Kami memilih jalur yang lebih aman.

examples.en: The safer path has been chosen.
examples.id: Jalur yang lebih aman sudah dipilih.

examples.en: I find the owner in the roster.
I found the owner in the roster.
The owner has been found.
We hold the release.
We held the release.
The release has been held.
I know the owner.
I knew the owner.
The risk is known.

She left the bridge at five.
She has left the bridge.
We meet the board at noon.
We met the board at noon.
We have met the board.
Customers pay by card.
Customers paid by card.
The invoice has been paid.
I put the note in the ticket.
I put the note in the ticket yesterday.
examples.id: Saya menaruh catatan di tiket kemarin.

examples.en: The note has been put in the ticket.
examples.id: Catatan itu sudah ditaruh di tiket.

We ran the backup last night.
The backup has run.
I say the risk is high.
I said the risk was high.
It has been said in the meeting.
examples.id: Hal itu sudah dikatakan di rapat.

examples.en: She speaks to the owner.
She spoke to the owner.
She has spoken to the owner.
I tell the team the status.
I told the team the status.
The team has been told.

examples.id: Saya pikir jeda itu lebih aman.

examples.en: I thought the pause was safer.
examples.id: Saya pikir jeda itu lebih aman.

examples.en: I have thought about the pause.

laws.whenId: Anda memberi kabar, status, atau fakta. Tidak ada kata tanya.

examples.en: The deploy finished at noon.
We need a decision today.

mistake.wrong: Finished the deploy at noon.
mistake.right: The deploy finished at noon.
mistake.whyId: Kalimat English butuh subjek. Jangan mulai dari kata kerja jika yang dibicarakan adalah bendanya.

laws.whenId: Anda meniadakan fakta: tidak, belum, atau tidak bisa.

examples.en: The budget doesn't cover the fix.
I am not blocked on the deploy.
examples.id: Saya tidak terhambat di proses deploy.

mistake.wrong: The budget not cover the fix.
mistake.right: The budget doesn't cover the fix.
mistake.whyId: Not tidak bisa menempel langsung pada kata kerja biasa. Sisipkan doesn't atau don't.

laws.whenId: Jawaban yang Anda harapkan hanya yes atau no.

examples.en: Does the backup include the ledger?
Is the demo ready?

mistake.wrong: The backup includes the ledger?
mistake.right: Does the backup include the ledger?
mistake.whyId: Nada tanya saja tidak cukup. Kata bantu pindah ke depan subjek.

laws.whenId: Anda butuh informasi: siapa, apa, kapan, di mana, mengapa, atau bagaimana.

examples.en: When does the window start?
Who owns the rollback?

mistake.wrong: When the window starts?
mistake.right: When does the window start?
mistake.whyId: Setelah kata tanya, kata bantu tetap berdiri di depan subjek. Start tidak memakai -s.

laws.whenId: Hampir semua kalimat kerja. Keterangan waktu atau tempat biasanya di akhir.

examples.en: We ship the change to canary tonight.
examples.id: Kami merilis perubahan ke canary malam ini.

examples.en: The query scans the table every night.
examples.id: Query itu memindai tabel setiap malam.

mistake.wrong: We the change ship tonight.
mistake.right: We ship the change tonight.
mistake.whyId: Objek duduk setelah kata kerja, bukan di antara subjek dan kata kerja.

laws.whenId: Anda menyusun chip dan salah satu bagian terasa hilang.

examples.en: We will restore the service tonight.
examples.id: Kami akan memulihkan layanan malam ini.

examples.en: The alert doesn't fire at night.
examples.id: Alert tidak berbunyi pada malam hari.

mistake.wrong: Will we restore the service tonight.
mistake.right: We will restore the service tonight.
mistake.whyId: Pada pernyataan, will tetap di belakang subjek. Will pindah ke depan hanya untuk pertanyaan.

laws.whenId: Keadaan, identitas, atau kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung.
laws.formula: I am / you are / he is + complement

examples.en: The risk is reputational.
We are testing the fix.

mistake.wrong: The risk are reputational.
mistake.right: The risk is reputational.
mistake.whyId: Subjek tunggal memakai is. Are untuk you, we, dan they.

laws.whenId: Negatif dan pertanyaan pada kata kerja biasa, bukan pada be.

examples.en: Does the estimate include testing?
We didn't carry the story forward.
examples.id: Kami tidak membawa cerita itu ke sprint berikutnya.

mistake.wrong: Does the estimate includes testing?
mistake.right: Does the estimate include testing?
mistake.whyId: Setelah does, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar. -s sudah dibawa oleh does.

laws.whenId: Menghubungkan masa lalu dengan sekarang, atau kepemilikan.

examples.en: We have closed the ticket.
The story has an owner.

mistake.wrong: We have close the ticket.
mistake.right: We have closed the ticket.
mistake.whyId: Setelah have/has untuk perfect, kata kerja memakai bentuk ketiga: closed, not close.

laws.whenId: Kebiasaan, fakta, jadwal, atau keadaan yang tetap.

examples.en: I work at the office every day.
examples.id: Saya bekerja di kantor setiap hari.

examples.en: The service meets the SLO.

mistake.wrong: The service meet the SLO.
mistake.right: The service meets the SLO.
mistake.whyId: He, she, it, dan benda tunggal menambah -s pada kata kerja present simple.

laws.whenId: Kegiatan yang sedang terjadi sekarang, atau rencana yang sudah pasti dekat.

examples.en: We are routing traffic to the healthy region.
examples.id: Kami sedang mengalihkan trafik ke region yang sehat.

examples.en: I am writing the decision record.

mistake.wrong: We routing traffic now.
mistake.right: We are routing traffic now.
mistake.whyId: Bentuk -ing butuh be. Tanpa are, kalimat itu belum lengkap.

laws.whenId: Kejadian yang selesai pada waktu lampau yang disebut atau tersirat.

examples.en: I checked the server before the meeting.
A new field broke old clients.

mistake.wrong: I check the server yesterday.
mistake.right: I checked the server yesterday.
mistake.whyId: Yesterday memaksa past. Check menjadi checked.

laws.whenId: Kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung ketika sesuatu yang lain terjadi.

examples.en: We were testing the fix when the alert fired.
examples.id: Kami sedang menguji perbaikan ketika alert berbunyi.

examples.en: The queue was growing during the demo.

mistake.wrong: We was testing the fix.
mistake.right: We were testing the fix.
mistake.whyId: We memakai were. Was untuk I, he, she, it.

laws.whenId: Hasilnya masih terasa sekarang, atau waktunya tidak disebut.

examples.en: We have rolled back the deployment.
Legal has reviewed the report.

mistake.wrong: We have rolled back the deployment yesterday.
mistake.right: We rolled back the deployment yesterday.
mistake.whyId: Yesterday adalah waktu selesai. Pakai past simple, bukan present perfect.

laws.whenId: Satu kejadian lampau terjadi lebih dulu daripada kejadian lampau yang lain.

examples.en: The backup had failed before we noticed the gap.
examples.id: Backup sudah gagal sebelum kami melihat celahnya.

examples.en: We had revoked the token before the partner called.
examples.id: Kami sudah mencabut token sebelum mitra menelepon.

mistake.wrong: The backup has failed before we noticed the gap.
mistake.right: The backup had failed before we noticed the gap.
mistake.whyId: Kedua kejadian ada di masa lalu. Yang lebih dulu memakai had, bukan has.

laws.whenId: Keadaan masih berjalan sejak suatu saat, dan Anda menyebut durasinya.

examples.en: I have been waiting for the token since noon.
examples.id: Saya sudah menunggu token sejak siang.

examples.en: The service has been failing since the deploy.
examples.id: Layanan itu sudah gagal sejak deploy.

mistake.wrong: I am waiting for the token since noon.
mistake.right: I have been waiting for the token since noon.
mistake.whyId: Since menandai awal yang masih berlanjut. Pakai have been + verb-ing, bukan am + verb-ing.

laws.whenId: Keputusan saat bicara, prediksi, atau janji.

examples.en: I will send an update soon.
examples.id: Saya akan mengirim kabar sebentar lagi.

examples.en: We will roll back on errors.
examples.id: Kami akan mengembalikan jika ada error.

mistake.wrong: I will sends an update soon.
mistake.right: I will send an update soon.
mistake.whyId: Setelah will, kata kerja tidak menambah -s.

laws.whenId: Rencana yang sudah ada, atau bukti yang sudah terlihat.
laws.formula: am / is / are + going to + base verb

examples.en: We are going to cut scope.
The disk is going to fill tonight.

mistake.wrong: We going to cut scope.
mistake.right: We are going to cut scope.
mistake.whyId: Going to butuh be. We memakai are.

laws.whenId: Waktu yang sudah ditetapkan: rapat, jendela rilis, keberangkatan.

examples.en: The window starts at midnight.
The review begins on Friday.

mistake.wrong: The window will starts at midnight.
mistake.right: The window starts at midnight.
mistake.whyId: Jadwal tetap memakai present simple. Will tidak ditambah -s, dan di sini will tidak diperlukan.

laws.titleId: Can, could, should, must, might, would
laws.whenId: Kemampuan, izin, saran, keharusan, kemungkinan, atau permintaan yang lebih halus.

examples.en: We should add a circuit breaker.
The partner might send the token twice.
examples.id: Mitra mungkin mengirim token dua kali.

mistake.wrong: We should to add a circuit breaker.
mistake.right: We should add a circuit breaker.
mistake.whyId: Modal tidak diikuti to. To hanya muncul pada going to, have to, dan beberapa infinitive.

laws.whenId: Anda menyatakan apa yang bisa dilakukan sekarang.

examples.en: I can restore the service from the backup.
examples.id: Saya bisa memulihkan layanan dari backup.

examples.en: The script can retry the payment.
examples.id: Skrip itu bisa mencoba pembayaran lagi.

mistake.wrong: I can to restore the service.
mistake.right: I can restore the service.
mistake.whyId: Can langsung diikuti kata kerja dasar. To tidak disisipkan.

laws.whenId: Anda menyarankan tindakan, bukan memerintah.

examples.en: We should pause the launch.
You should page the owner first.

mistake.wrong: We should pausing the launch.
mistake.right: We should pause the launch.
mistake.whyId: Should diikuti kata kerja dasar, bukan verb-ing.

laws.whenId: Tindakan itu wajib. Must dari pembicara. Have to dari aturan atau keadaan.
laws.formula: must + base verb; have / has to + base verb

examples.en: We must close the incident before the board call.
examples.id: Kami harus menutup insiden sebelum panggilan Direksi.

examples.en: Legal has to review the contract.

mistake.wrong: Legal must to review the contract.
mistake.right: Legal has to review the contract.
mistake.whyId: Must tidak memakai to. Kewajiban dari aturan memakai has to.

laws.titleId: Must not lawan don't have to
laws.whenId: Must not melarang. Don't have to berarti tidak wajib.
laws.formula: must not + base verb; don't / doesn't have to + base verb

examples.en: You must not share the token.
examples.id: Kamu tidak boleh membagikan token itu.

examples.en: You don't have to join the retro.

mistake.wrong: You don't have to share the token.
mistake.right: You must not share the token.
mistake.whyId: Don't have to hanya berarti tidak wajib. Larangan memakai must not.

laws.whenId: Hasilnya belum pasti, dan Anda tidak ingin terdengar seperti janji.

examples.en: The partner might send the token twice.
examples.id: Mitra mungkin mengirim token dua kali.

examples.en: The fix might slip to Monday.

mistake.wrong: The fix might to slip to Monday.
mistake.right: The fix might slip to Monday.
mistake.whyId: Might langsung diikuti kata kerja dasar.

laws.whenId: Menolak keadaan atau identitas.

examples.en: The demo is not ready.
Customers aren't blocked.

mistake.wrong: The demo doesn't be ready.
mistake.right: The demo isn't ready.
mistake.whyId: Be tidak memakai don't atau doesn't. Not duduk setelah is, am, atau are.

laws.whenId: Menolak kata kerja biasa pada present atau past.

examples.en: The logs don't show the error.
I didn't recommend a pause.

mistake.wrong: The logs don't shows the error.
mistake.right: The logs don't show the error.
mistake.whyId: Setelah don't, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar.

laws.whenId: Tidak bisa, tidak boleh, tidak harus, atau mungkin tidak.

examples.en: Customers can't pay.
You must not share passwords.
examples.id: Anda tidak boleh berbagi kata sandi.

mistake.wrong: You don't must share passwords.
mistake.right: You must not share passwords.
mistake.whyId: Not menempel pada modal. Jangan menambah don't di depan must.

laws.whenId: Anda hanya butuh ya atau tidak.

examples.en: Can we restore the backup?
Did the manager approve the change?

mistake.wrong: Did the manager approved the change?
mistake.right: Did the manager approve the change?
mistake.whyId: Did sudah menandai past. Kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar.

laws.whenId: Informasi yang hilang: what, when, where, why, how, which.

examples.en: Why did the date slip?
Where does the report read from?

mistake.wrong: Why the date slipped?
mistake.right: Why did the date slip?
mistake.whyId: Kata tanya tidak menggantikan kata bantu. Did tetap diperlukan.

laws.whenId: Who atau what yang menanyakan pelaku tidak memakai do. Yang menanyakan objek memakai do.
laws.formula: Who + Verb-s?  /  Who + do/does + Subject + Verb?

examples.en: Who owns the ticket?
Who did you notify?

mistake.wrong: Who does own the ticket?
mistake.right: Who owns the ticket?
mistake.whyId: Jika who adalah subjek, tidak ada do. Does hanya muncul jika who adalah objek.

laws.whenId: Anda bertanya dengan sopan di dalam kalimat, biasanya ke manajer atau Direksi.
laws.formula: Could you tell me + wh- + subject + verb

examples.en: Could you clarify what success looks like?
examples.id: Bisakah Anda menjelaskan seperti apa keberhasilan itu?

examples.en: Do you know when the window starts?

mistake.wrong: Could you tell me when does the window start?
mistake.right: Could you tell me when the window starts?
mistake.whyId: Di dalam pertanyaan tidak langsung, urutan kembali menjadi subjek + kata kerja. Does tidak pindah ke depan.

laws.whenId: Anda memastikan fakta di rapat, bukan membuka pertanyaan baru.
laws.formula: positive statement + negative tag; negative statement + positive tag

examples.en: The deploy is tonight, isn't it?
You haven't approved the access, have you?

mistake.wrong: The deploy is tonight, is it?
mistake.right: The deploy is tonight, isn't it?
mistake.whyId: Pernyataan positif memakai tag negatif. Is menjadi isn't.

laws.whenId: Menjawab yes/no tanpa mengulang seluruh kalimat.
laws.formula: Yes, subject + auxiliary. / No, subject + auxiliary + not.

examples.en: Yes, it does.
No, we haven't.

mistake.wrong: Yes, it includes.
mistake.right: Yes, it does.
mistake.whyId: Jawaban singkat mengulang kata bantu, bukan kata kerja utamanya.

laws.whenId: Menanggapi pendapat di rapat tanpa membuka kalimat baru yang panjang.
laws.formula: So + auxiliary + subject. / Neither + auxiliary + subject.

examples.en: So do I.
I see your point, but the risk is higher.
examples.id: Saya paham maksudnya, tetapi risikonya lebih tinggi.

mistake.wrong: I am agree.
mistake.right: I agree.
mistake.whyId: Agree adalah kata kerja. Tidak perlu am.

laws.whenId: A/an untuk benda yang baru disebut dan tunggal. The untuk benda yang sudah diketahui.
laws.formula: a/an + singular new noun; the + known noun

examples.en: We need a decision today.
examples.id: Kami butuh sebuah keputusan hari ini.

examples.en: The decision is due on Friday.
examples.id: Keputusan itu jatuh tempo hari Jumat.

mistake.wrong: We need decision today.
mistake.right: We need a decision today.
mistake.whyId: Benda tunggal yang bisa dihitung butuh a atau the. Decision di sini baru disebut, jadi a.

laws.whenId: Membedakan satu, banyak, dan benda yang tidak dihitung.

examples.en: We have few failing tests.
There is little headroom.

mistake.wrong: We have much failing tests.
mistake.right: We have many failing tests.
mistake.whyId: Tests bisa dihitung dan jamak, jadi many. Much untuk benda yang tidak dihitung, seperti headroom atau time.

laws.whenId: Some untuk pernyataan dan tawaran. Any untuk kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan ya/tidak.
laws.formula: some in statements; any in negatives and yes/no questions

examples.en: We have some failing tests.
examples.id: Kami punya beberapa tes yang gagal.

examples.en: Do we have any headroom?
examples.id: Apakah kita masih punya sisa kapasitas?

mistake.wrong: We don't have some failing tests.
mistake.right: We don't have any failing tests.
mistake.whyId: Kalimat negatif memakai any, bukan some.

laws.whenId: Anda memperkenalkan sesuatu yang ada, bukan menamai subjek yang sudah dikenal.
laws.formula: There is + singular; There are + plural

examples.en: There is a blocker on the deploy.
There are two failing checks.

mistake.wrong: There are a blocker on the deploy.
mistake.right: There is a blocker on the deploy.
mistake.whyId: Blocker tunggal memakai there is. There are untuk yang jamak.

laws.whenId: Mengganti nama yang sudah disebut agar kalimat tidak mengulang.

examples.en: The owner approved it.
Please send the note to me.
examples.id: Tolong kirim catatan itu kepada saya.

mistake.wrong: Please send the note to I.
mistake.right: Please send the note to me.
mistake.whyId: Setelah to, kata ganti memakai bentuk objek: me, bukan I.

laws.whenId: Kata sifat menerangkan benda. Keterangan menerangkan kata kerja.

examples.en: This is a careful review.
Please review the change carefully.
examples.id: Tolong tinjau perubahan itu dengan cermat.

mistake.wrong: Please review the change careful.
mistake.right: Please review the change carefully.
mistake.whyId: Yang diterangkan adalah cara meninjau, jadi carefully, bukan careful.

laws.whenId: Menempatkan jam, hari, atau bulan.
laws.formula: at + clock; on + day; in + month/year

examples.en: The window starts at midnight.
The access expires on Friday.

mistake.wrong: The access expires in Friday.
mistake.right: The access expires on Friday.
mistake.whyId: Hari memakai on. In untuk bulan, tahun, atau bagian hari yang panjang seperti in the morning.

laws.whenId: Menempatkan orang atau layanan.
laws.formula: at + point; in + area; on + surface/system

examples.en: I work at the office.
The bug is on staging.

mistake.wrong: The bug is in staging.
mistake.right: The bug is on staging.
mistake.whyId: Nama lingkungan seperti staging, canary, atau production memakai on.

laws.whenId: Menggabungkan dua ide: tambahan, kontras, alasan, waktu, atau syarat.

examples.en: Error rates spiked, so we rolled back.
examples.id: Tingkat error melonjak, jadi kami mengembalikan rilis.

examples.en: Call me when the backup finishes.

mistake.wrong: Because the backup failed. We paged the team.
mistake.right: We paged the team because the backup failed.
mistake.whyId: Because butuh dua klausa dalam satu kalimat. Klausa alasan tidak berdiri sendiri.

laws.whenId: Nol untuk fakta yang selalu benar. Pertama untuk syarat yang masih mungkin.
laws.formula: If + present, present. / If + present, will + verb

examples.en: If the disk fills, the node stops.
If the queue keeps growing, we will scale the workers.
examples.id: Jika antrean terus membesar, kami akan memperbesar jumlah worker.

mistake.wrong: If the queue will keep growing, we scale the workers.
mistake.right: If the queue keeps growing, we will scale the workers.
mistake.whyId: Will duduk di akibat, bukan di dalam if.

laws.whenId: Kedua untuk andaian sekarang. Ketiga untuk andaian masa lalu yang tidak terjadi.
laws.formula: If + past, would + verb. / If + had + participle, would have + participle

examples.en: If we had more headroom, we would skip the throttle.
examples.id: Jika sisa kapasitas lebih besar, kami tidak akan membatasi klien.

examples.en: If we had tested on canary, we would have caught the break.
examples.id: Jika kami menguji di canary, kami sudah menemukan kerusakannya.

mistake.wrong: If we would have tested on canary, we caught the break.
mistake.right: If we had tested on canary, we would have caught the break.
mistake.whyId: Would tidak masuk ke dalam if. Had menandai syarat yang sudah lewat.

laws.whenId: Syarat negatif: jika tidak.

examples.en: Unless the owner approves, we will wait.
examples.id: Jika pemilik tidak menyetujui, kami akan menunggu.

examples.en: Don't ship unless the tests pass.
examples.id: Jangan rilis jika tes tidak lulus.

mistake.wrong: Unless the owner doesn't approve, we will wait.
mistake.right: Unless the owner approves, we will wait.
mistake.whyId: Unless sudah berarti jika tidak. Jangan menambah not lagi.

laws.whenId: Yang penting adalah bendanya, bukan pelakunya. Sering untuk status insiden dan akses.

examples.en: The ticket was closed.
Access is granted for one day.

mistake.wrong: The ticket was close.
mistake.right: The ticket was closed.
mistake.whyId: Pasif butuh bentuk ketiga. Close menjadi closed.

laws.whenId: Status itu wajib, boleh, atau sebaiknya, dan pelakunya tidak penting.
laws.formula: must / can / should + be + past participle

examples.en: The ticket must be closed today.
examples.id: Tiket itu harus ditutup hari ini.

examples.en: The diff can be reviewed tomorrow.

mistake.wrong: The ticket must closed today.
mistake.right: The ticket must be closed today.
mistake.whyId: Modal pasif butuh be sebelum bentuk ketiga. Must closed belum lengkap.

laws.whenId: Anda menyampaikan apa yang dikatakan orang lain, biasanya satu waktu ke belakang.

examples.en: She said the deploy was blocked.
He asked whether the demo was ready.
examples.id: Dia bertanya apakah demo sudah siap.

mistake.wrong: She said the deploy is blocked yesterday.
mistake.right: She said the deploy was blocked.
mistake.whyId: Saat melaporkan ucapan lampau, is biasanya mundur menjadi was. Yesterday tidak menempel pada is.

laws.whenId: Anda melaporkan apa yang diminta orang lain, bukan hanya apa yang dikatakan.

examples.en: She asked us to hold the release.
He asked me to send the note today.
examples.id: Dia meminta saya mengirim catatan itu hari ini.

mistake.wrong: She asked us hold the release.
mistake.right: She asked us to hold the release.
mistake.whyId: Permintaan yang dilaporkan memakai to sebelum kata kerja.

laws.whenId: Membandingkan dua opsi atau menyatakan tingkat tertinggi.
laws.formula: adjective-er than; more + long adjective; as + adjective + as

examples.en: Option A costs more than option B.
examples.id: Opsi A lebih mahal daripada opsi B.

examples.en: This path is as safe as the old one.
examples.id: Jalur ini sama amannya dengan yang lama.

mistake.wrong: Option A is more cheaper.
mistake.right: Option A is cheaper.
mistake.whyId: Kata sifat pendek memakai -er, bukan more. More untuk kata yang panjang, seperti expensive.

laws.whenId: Menambahkan keterangan pada orang atau benda tanpa memulai kalimat baru.

examples.en: The engineer who owns the ticket is out.
examples.id: Insinyur yang memiliki tiket itu sedang tidak masuk.

examples.en: The change that broke checkout is rolled back.
examples.id: Perubahan yang merusak checkout sudah dikembalikan.

mistake.wrong: The engineer which owns the ticket is out.
mistake.right: The engineer who owns the ticket is out.
mistake.whyId: Orang memakai who. Which untuk benda.

laws.whenId: Setelah kata kerja tertentu, bentuk lanjutannya sudah tetap.

examples.en: I suggest pausing the launch.
We decided to postpone the release.

mistake.wrong: I suggest to pause the launch.
mistake.right: I suggest pausing the launch.
mistake.whyId: Suggest diikuti verb-ing, bukan to.

laws.whenId: Anda butuh tindakan orang lain dan nadanya harus sopan.

examples.en: Could you approve the access today?
examples.id: Bisakah Anda menyetujui aksesnya hari ini?

examples.en: Would you mind reviewing the diff?

mistake.wrong: Approve the access today.
mistake.right: Could you approve the access today?
mistake.whyId: Perintah telanjang terdengar kasar. Could you membuatnya permintaan.

laws.whenId: Anda tidak bisa memenuhi permintaan, dan alasannya singkat.
laws.formula: I'm afraid + subject + can't + verb, because...

examples.en: I'm afraid we can't ship today because the tests are red.
examples.id: Maaf, kami tidak bisa merilis hari ini karena tes masih gagal.

examples.en: I can't grant production access without a ticket.
examples.id: Saya tidak bisa memberi akses produksi tanpa tiket.

mistake.wrong: No, impossible.
mistake.right: I'm afraid we can't ship today.
mistake.whyId: Penolakan kerja menyebut batasannya dalam kalimat utuh, bukan satu kata.

laws.whenId: Ada dampak ke orang lain dan Anda menyebut perbaikan berikutnya.
laws.formula: I'm sorry for + noun/verb-ing. We will + verb.

examples.en: I'm sorry for the delay. We will send the note today.
examples.id: Maaf atas penundaannya. Kami akan mengirim catatan hari ini.

examples.en: Sorry about the failed deploy. The service is stable now.
examples.id: Maaf soal deploy yang gagal. Layanannya sudah stabil.

mistake.wrong: I am sorry for delay the release.
mistake.right: I am sorry for delaying the release.
mistake.whyId: Setelah for, pakai noun atau verb-ing. Delay sebagai kata kerja menjadi delaying.

laws.whenId: Update singkat: apa yang terjadi, dampaknya, dan langkah berikutnya.

examples.en: Checkout is degraded. We are rolling back now.
examples.id: Checkout menurun. Kami sedang mengembalikan rilis sekarang.

examples.en: The migration finished. No customers were blocked.
examples.id: Migrasinya selesai. Tidak ada pelanggan yang terhambat.

mistake.wrong: There is some issue happening maybe.
mistake.right: Checkout is degraded. We are rolling back now.
mistake.whyId: Status kerja menyebut layanan, keadaannya, dan tindakan. Maybe tidak menggantikan fakta.

laws.whenId: Audiensnya Direksi. Satu kalimat, tanpa jargon, dengan hasil atau keputusan.
laws.formula: Result or risk + what you need

examples.en: The outage cost revenue. We need a decision today.
examples.id: Insiden itu mengurangi pendapatan. Kami butuh keputusan hari ini.

examples.en: Customers can still pay. I recommend a pause on the launch.
examples.id: Pelanggan masih bisa membayar. Saya menyarankan jeda peluncuran.

mistake.wrong: The canary latency p99 regressed after the sidecar rollout.
mistake.right: Customers are slower to pay. We recommend a pause.
mistake.whyId: Direksi butuh akibat bisnis dan permintaan keputusan, bukan nama komponen.
